mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT role.id id, role.name name FROM ums_user u INNER JOIN ums_user_role_relation uurr on u.id = uurr.user_id INNER JOIN ums_role role on uurr.role_id = role.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT r.* FROM ums_role_resource_relation rrr LEFT JOIN ums_resource r ON rrr.resource_id = r.id WHERE rrr.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.id IS NOT NULL
SELECT o.* FROM ums_role_option_relation ror INNER JOIN ums_option o on ror.option_id = o.id WHERE ror.role_id = #{roleId}
